items.title: Xiaomi’s 1,548 hp electric supercar is going global, starting in the UAE
items.raw_content: As a red wave of Chinese-built electric vehicles breaks over Europe and Canada, Xiaomi is selling its electric cars outside of China for the first time ever – and its starting its push for global growth with the UAE in 2027. more…
items.title_zh: 小米 1,548 马力电动超跑走向全球，首站阿联酋
items.summary: Xiaomi will sell its electric cars outside China for the first time, starting with the UAE in 2027, as Chinese-built EVs push into Europe and Canada.

items.title: Rumor: Hyundai is getting ready to roll out an all-new, all-electric work truck
items.raw_content: The last time Hyundai announced a new work truck was 22 years ago, and the Hyundai Porter has proven itself as a dependable workhorse throughout Korea and Southeast Asia – but only the pyramids and the Chevy Express can last forever. Hyundai is reportedly getting ready to pull the wraps off an all-new Porter pickup. This time, it’s electric . more…
items.title_zh: 传闻：现代准备推出全新纯电工作皮卡
items.summary: Hyundai is reportedly preparing to unveil an all-new, all-electric version of its Porter pickup, 22 years after the company's last new work truck.

items.title: E-quipment highlight: Tadano rolls out 35-ton V320RC electric crane
items.raw_content: Developed by Japanese material handling giant Tadano, the 35-ton V320RC wheeled electric pick & carry crane has spent the last few months proving itself at NMG Italia’s job sites, where it’s been handling heavy loads in tight industrial spaces and improving efficiency by 50%. And now, you can buy one. more…
items.title_zh: 设备聚焦：Tadano 推出 35 吨 V320RC 电动起重机
items.summary: Tadano's 35-ton V320RC wheeled electric pick-and-carry crane is now on sale after several months of trials at NMG Italia job sites, where the company says it improved efficiency by 50%.

items.title: From equipment to ferries to locomotives, Illinois ports are getting a ZEV makeover
items.raw_content: The Illinois Clean Ports Program is putting $104 million behind efforts to help clean up its working waterfronts, funds earmarked for heavy-duty electric equipment assets that includes forklifts, giant reach stackers, switcher locomotives, and the charging equipment needed to support them. There’s even a passenger ferry! more…
items.title_zh: 从设备到渡轮再到机车，伊利诺伊州港口迎来零排放改造
items.summary: Illinois is directing $104 million through its Clean Ports Program to electrify heavy-duty equipment at working waterfronts, from forklifts and reach stackers to switcher locomotives, charging gear and a passenger ferry.

items.title: The Google Home app is better than Nest alone ever was, mostly
items.raw_content: The Nest app is officially dead, but it’s worth taking a step back and remembering that, while there are some rough edges, the Google Home app is a better smart home experience than Nest alone ever could have been. 9to5Google Weekender by Ben Schoon is a part of our free newsletter that also includes ‘Inbox,’ a twice-weekly roundup of key stories from around the web by Daniel Bader. Sign up here to get Weekender delivered to your inbox every Sunday along with ‘Inbox’ on Tuesday and Thursday. You can find past issues here . Sign up below to access the web version. more…
items.title_zh: Google Home 应用比单用 Nest 更好用，但仍有短板
items.summary: With the Nest app now officially retired, 9to5Google argues that the Google Home app delivers a better smart-home experience overall, despite some rough edges.

items.title: Briggs & Stratton keeps the lights on longer with bigger 16 kWh LFP battery
items.raw_content: For decades, Briggs & Stratton has helped keep the lights on after the storm with its gas-powered generators. Now, the company is bringing that legacy to the electric age with a new 16 kWh backup battery designed to scale with your growing energy needs. more…
items.title_zh: Briggs & Stratton 推出 16 kWh 磷酸铁锂备用电池，延长断电续航
items.summary: Briggs & Stratton is adding a 16 kWh LFP backup battery designed to scale with growing household energy needs, extending its generator business into electric backup power.

items.title: Samsung Galaxy Watch Ultra 2 vs Watch 9: When is it right to spend more?
items.raw_content: The Samsung Galaxy Watch Ultra 2 is worth spending more on if you want longer battery life, a brighter outdoor display, and specialized features for trail running and diving. The Galaxy Watch 9 is the better fit if you want Samsung’s latest everyday health tools in a smaller, lighter watch. Both, however, are fantastic smartwatches with limitless potential. They share a Snapdragon Wear Elite processor and many of Samsung’s newest wellness features, so deciding between them is really about figuring out your priorities when it comes to buying a wearable this holiday season. We’re here to help you figure that out. more…
items.title_zh: 三星 Galaxy Watch Ultra 2 对比 Watch 9：何时值得多花钱？
items.summary: The Galaxy Watch Ultra 2 is the better pick for longer battery life, a brighter outdoor display and trail-running or diving features, while the smaller, lighter Watch 9 focuses on everyday health tracking; both use a Snapdragon Wear Elite processor.

items.title: UGREEN’s excellent liquid cooled 25W MagSafe battery for iPhone is now 40% off

items.summary: UGREEN's Qi2.2 25W 10,000mAh MagSafe battery bank, which stands out for its liquid-cooling design, is 40% off for Black Friday.

items.title: MacBook Neo 2 likely to launch around March, could feature new colors: report
items.raw_content: One of Apple’s most beloved products this year was undoubtedly the MacBook Neo . Unlike some of its other budget products, Apple seems interested in updating the MacBook Neo on an annual cycle, and we may get the next MacBook Neo around March. more…
items.title_zh: 报告称 MacBook Neo 2 或于 3 月前后发布，可能新增配色
items.summary: A report suggests Apple may launch the next MacBook Neo around March, possibly in new colors, as the company appears to be moving the budget laptop to an annual update cycle.

Powerful bass, room-filling sound, up to 12 hours of battery life, IP67 durability, stereo pairing support, and much more. more…

items.title: 11-term House rep who mocked a kid’s letter about EVs has lost her seat (Upd.)
items.raw_content: An 83 year old Congressional representative who sent an embarrassing letter to a well-meaning 10 year old constituent on the topic of electric cars and climate change, where she seems to brag about saddling his generation with debt through a recent climate rollback she voted for, has lost her seat. Update: This article was originally posted on May 14, but we wanted to update it with news of the election result. After a recount, Chuck Hubbard has defeated Virginia Foxx by 330 votes, and will go on to represent NC-5 in Congress. more…
items.title_zh: 嘲讽儿童电动车来信的 11 届众议员落选
items.summary: After a recount, Chuck Hubbard defeated Virginia Foxx by 330 votes to represent North Carolina's 5th District, unseating the 11-term representative whose letter to a 10-year-old constituent about EVs drew criticism.
